ai_review.summary: A peer‑less soundboard capture of an unforgettable Fillmore night, highlighted by guest appearances and Jerry’s rare piano work on “To Lay Me Down.”
ai_review.review: All three reviewers rave about this show as one of the greatest ever, praising the historic guest spot with Nelson, Grisman and the acoustic set where Phil added electric bass. The restoration work is described as clean, beautiful and sounding amazing, making it a definitive version for listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently 5‑star reviews emphasize an exceptional performance and a flawless, expertly restored soundboard recording, warranting near‑top rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviews highlight the clean‑up work, crystal‑clear mix and overall beautiful sound; no complaints about dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is remembered as a historic Fillmore run with guest artists, an electric‑bass‑enhanced acoustic set and seamless energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted for playing piano on “To Lay Me Down” and overall superb performance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Added his electric bass to the acoustic set, a memorable moment praised by reviewers.
